headlines.title: 11월 개인 투자용 국채 2천억원 발행 예정
headlines.summary: 다음 달 11∼17일 청약기간 국고채 (PG) [강민지 제작] 일러스트 (세종=연합뉴스) 안채원 기자 = 재정경제부는 다음 달 개인 투자용 국채를 총 2천억원 발행할 예정이라고 29일 밝혔다. 종목별로는 3년물 이표채 20억원, 3년물 복리채 30억원을 발행하고, 5년물은 200억원, 10년물은 1천400억원, 20년물은 350억원을 발행할 계획이다.

headlines.title: 11월 개인투자용 국채 2000억 발행 … 내달 11~17일 청약
headlines.summary: 10년물 1400억·20년물 350억원 발행 20년물 만기 보유 시 세전 수익률 162.6% 전용계좌·퇴직연금계좌 통해 청약 가능 [서울=뉴시스] [세종=뉴시스]여동준 기자 = 재정경제부가 다음 달 개인투자용 국채를 총 2000억원 규모로 발행한다. 재경부는 29일 이 같은 내용의 '11월 개인투자용 국채 발행계획'을 발표했다.

headlines.title: 퇴직금 체불 ' 원천차단 '… 노후소득보장·수익률 제고 시험대
headlines.summary: 2030년까지 전 사업장 의무화 전문법인 일임 '기금형' 신설 '자동 연금지급'으로 노후 보장 정부가 발표한 퇴직연금 개편안은 2005년 제도 도입 이후 20여년 만의 구조 개편이다. 체불 방지에 머물던 퇴직급여 제도를 전문 운용을 통한 수익률 제고와 노후소득 보장까지 아우르는 체계로 바꾸겠다는 구상이다.

headlines.title: 경영계 “ 중소·영세기업 여건 충분히 고려해야 ”
headlines.summary: 경총, 정부 퇴직연금 기능강화 방안에 입장문 노후소득보장 취지 공감, 중소기업 고려해야 기금형 퇴직연금, 손실 대비한 보호장치 필요 경영계가 정부의 퇴직급여 사외적립 의무화 방침에 대해 근로자의 노후소득 보장이라는 취지에는 공감하면서도 중소·영세기업의 부담을 고려한 제도 시행의 필요성을 강조했다.

headlines.summary: ■ 정부, 8·13 대책 후속조치 모두 서울 경계서 5㎞ 이내 지역 기존발표지 합쳐 총 10.4만 가구 정부가 ‘주택 신속 공급방안’후속 조치로 추가 신규택지를 발표한 가운데 3.7만호가 공급될 경기 김포 고촌읍 부지 모습.

headlines.title: 7.7만호 실입주 까지 빨라야 10년 안팎 …집값 안정 '속도전'에 달렸다
headlines.summary: 서울 경계 5㎞ 경기 6곳 선정 기존 신도시·철도망 활용해 속도전 서울 강남권 그린벨트 해제는 무산 실제 입주는 2030년대 중반 전망 29일 국토교통부가 발표한 수도권 신규택지 후보지 6곳(7만6700가구)은 모두 서울 경계에서 5㎞ 안에 있는 수도권 개발제한구역(그린벨트)에 자리 잡았다.

headlines.title: ‘ 강남아파트 거래절벽 오자 ’… 집값 소폭 하락·전세는 상승
headlines.summary: 서울 84㎡ 매매가 2.5% 하락 전셋값은 1년만에 3.8% 상승 “공급대책, 불안 완화엔 한계” 연합뉴스 전세보증금은 오히려 상승한 가운데 정부가 추가 발표한 신규택지 7만6700호에도 서울 공급 물량이 없어 주택 공급 부족과 전월세 시장 불안을 단기간에 해소하기는 어려울 것이란 전망이 나온다.

headlines.title: 계층상승 더 힘들어졌다 … 2024년 소득분위 상향 이동 '최저'
headlines.summary: 소득이동성 4년째 하락세…"성장의 과실 모두가 못 누려" 소득상향, 청년층 줄고 노인은 개선…청년 고용부진 영향 최하위 탈출률도 29.3%로 후퇴…최상위는 86.5%가 유지 대학일자리 플러스 센터 [연합뉴스 자료사진] (세종=연합뉴스) 송정은 기자 = 한 해 동안 소득이 늘어 계층(소득분위)이 올라간 국민이 10명 중 2명에도 못 미쳤다.

headlines.title: '개천에서 용 나기' 어려워졌나 … 소득계층 이동률 역대 최저
headlines.summary: 핵심요약 하위 20% 10명 중 7명은 이듬해도 같은 계층…상위 20%는 9명 가까이 유지 소득계층 바뀐 사람 33.0%…상향·하향 이동 모두 감소 청년층 이동률 39.3%로 가장 높지만 상향 이동은 전년보다 줄어 2024년 소득이동통계. 국가데이터처 제공 지난해 소득계층이 바뀐 사람의 비율이 통계 작성 이래 가장 낮은 수준으로 떨어졌다.

headlines.title: 원화 강세에 달러대출 급증 … 연중 최고치

headlines.title: “ 무역보험공사 지방 이전하면 수출 중소기업 애로 ”
headlines.summary: 기업들 “실무적 어려움 커져” 정부의 2차 공공기관 지방이전에 한국산업은행·한국무역보험공사 등의 이전 가능성이 제기되고 있다. 하지만 이전 추진 과정에서 기관의 기능 수행 논의가 후순위로 밀려 기관 경쟁력이 떨어질 것이란 우려가 커지고 있다.

key_headlines.title: Seoul Apartment Sales Decline 2.5% While Jeonse Prices Surge 3.8%
key_headlines.summary: Seoul's 84 square meter apartment sales prices fell 2.5% year-over-year in Q3, while jeonse (long-term lease) prices jumped 3.8% in one year. Government housing supply measures show limited effectiveness in addressing short-term market instability.

key_headlines.title: South Korea's Business Sentiment Index Reaches 4-Year High Amid Semiconductor Recovery
key_headlines.summary: The Bank of Korea's October corporate business sentiment index (CBSI) hit 104.2, the highest in 4 years and 2 months, with manufacturing at 105.6. The semiconductor sector's strength is spreading to SMEs and domestic companies after 6 years of maximum growth.

key_headlines.title: Post-Semiconductor Era: Government Pursues 8 Strategic Industries for Export Growth
key_headlines.summary: South Korea aims to diversify beyond semiconductors, which accounted for 49.9% of September exports, by cultivating eight strategic sectors including shipbuilding and defense. The country seeks to develop new growth engines as AI-driven semiconductor boom faces uncertainty.

key_headlines.title: U.S. Q3 GDP Surges 3.4% Driven by AI Investment and Consumer Spending
key_headlines.summary: U.S. third quarter GDP growth of 3.4% exceeded expectations as AI infrastructure investment and persistent consumer spending offset inflation concerns. The Federal Reserve held rates steady at 3.75-4.00% and signaled potential rate hikes in December.

key_headlines.title: UBS Lowers KOSPI Target from 8000 to 7500 Citing Won Strength and Earnings Pressure
key_headlines.summary: UBS downgraded its KOSPI year-end target to 7500 points from 8000 due to currency headwinds and lowered earnings forecasts. The investment bank expects recovery from 2025 onwards with a 9300-point target for next year.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's economy is experiencing mixed signals with strong corporate sentiment reaching 4-year highs, particularly in semiconductors, while housing market tension persists. The semiconductor sector's dominance in exports at 49.9% is prompting government focus on diversifying into eight strategic industries including shipbuilding, defense, and advanced materials. SMEs and domestic companies are beginning to benefit from the semiconductor recovery, though supply chain weakness remains a concern. Business confidence has expanded beyond exporters, reaching the broadest improvement in 6 years, suggesting the recovery is becoming more widespread.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: South Korea's Q3 real GDP growth of 1.0% quarter-over-quarter significantly exceeded the Bank of Korea's forecast of 0.3%, positioning the country for 3.6% annual growth even if Q4 growth stalls. The government is implementing additional housing supply measures with 76,700 new housing lots announced, though these show limited immediate effectiveness in stabilizing the jeonse market. The finance ministry announced 200 billion won in individual government bonds for November subscription with competitive yields, including 162.6% pre-tax returns on 20-year maturities. Both the U.S. and South Korea face synchronized monetary policy challenges, with the Federal Reserve holding rates steady at 3.75-4.00% while signaling potential December increases.
sections.Financial Markets: The KOSPI closed at 6,012.44, gaining 374.10 points (6.63%), with the won-dollar exchange rate at 1,337.7 won. UBS revised its KOSPI target downward from 8,000 to 7,500 points due to won strength and declining earnings forecasts, though it expects recovery to 9,300 points next year. Market attention remains focused on December FOMC decisions, AI investment sustainability, and Middle East geopolitical risks affecting oil prices. The Federal Reserve's announcement to reduce annual FOMC meetings from 8 to 6 by 2028 signals a measured approach to monetary policy normalization.
sections.Industry & Technology: The battery industry shows recovery signs driven by ESS market strength and European EV market growth, though materials and component suppliers await broader improvement. Battery industry leaders are pushing for government direct cash refund systems on production tax credits to support deficit companies. The government is expanding strategic technology designation to include aerospace, robotics, defense, and shipbuilding sectors, signaling commitment to post-semiconductor industrial diversification. AI adoption is shifting toward cost-efficiency, with companies prioritizing lower-cost, high-efficiency models, while advanced technology commercialization still faces barriers including raw material costs and insufficient field validation data.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul's third quarter apartment prices declined 2.5% year-over-year while jeonse prices surged 3.8%, reflecting severe supply-demand imbalances. Seoul's 2026 apartment supply is projected at 17,698 units, the lowest in 13 years and 45% below the previous year, creating a perfect storm of supply shortage, price increases, and limited new home access. Affordable housing units are emerging, with some priced at 300 million won in areas where comparable complexes cost 1.1 billion won, though these require long-term land lease arrangements. New apartment lottery lottery projects like Gwacheon Diotre Prestige and Godeok Kang-il 3 Complex remain highly competitive despite broader market softness.
sections.International Economy: The U.S. Federal Reserve held rates at 3.75-4.00% while signaling possible December increases, with strong Q3 GDP growth of 3.4% and persistent inflation pressures limiting immediate easing. Fed Chair Kevin Powell highlighted special interest in South Korea's economy, emphasizing its role as a critical advanced technology supplier and expressing confidence in Korea's economic management. The central bank announced plans to reduce annual FOMC meetings from 8 to 7 in 2027 and 6 in 2028, representing a 46-year precedent change. China's economic data reliability faces increased scrutiny amid youth unemployment statistics manipulation and discrepancies between official unemployment and consumer sentiment.
sections.AI & Economy: U.S. AI investment and consumption drove Q3 GDP growth of 3.4%, with major tech firms pouring capital into data centers, semiconductors, and computing equipment. The AI market is shifting from performance competition to cost-efficiency focus, with OpenAI's GPT-4o and Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5 offering significant price reductions while maintaining performance. Microsoft posted strong Q3 results with 25 trillion won in cash remaining after major AI infrastructure investments, while Google's parent Alphabet spent 12 trillion won more than earnings, raising investor concerns about ROI sustainability. Advanced technology commercialization faces barriers despite strong R&D achievements, with hydrogen, biotech, and AI requiring economic feasibility validation and field testing before industrial scale-up.
sections.Others: Hyundai Motor's quarterly revenue declined for the first time in 6 years, partly offset by favorable currency effects contributing 1.28 trillion won to operating profit as the won strengthened. SK sold 100% of SK Signet's shares to SK Electlink for up to 200 billion won, including 75 billion won upfront and conditional payments of up to 125 billion won based on 2028-2029 performance targets. NH Investment and Securities' Namu MTS platform won top innovation awards at the 2026 Asia Smart Finance Awards, advancing from basic stock trading to AI and big data-powered comprehensive digital investment platform. U.S. computer science enrollments dropped over 10% in graduate programs and 12% in undergraduate programs as AI advances create job market uncertainty for technology professionals.
